children: Independence Realty Trust agreed to acquire Centerspace in an all-stock merger, offering 3.800 shares of Independence Realty Trust common stock for each Centerspace share. The transaction, unanimously approved by both boards, is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to shareholder approvals and other customary conditions, with an outside date of June 30, 2027. The merger agreement provides for termination fees of $45 million (Centerspace) or $60 million (Independence Realty Trust). To support the deal and address Centerspace indebtedness, Independence Realty Trust Operating Partnership obtained a $716 million senior unsecured 364-day term loan commitment from Royal Bank of Canada, with two optional six-month extensions.
